interpretation: No chat-generation slowdown observed in this paired sample. Short chat prefill increased 15–19 ms; corpus results were mixed and variable. Native capacity is not universally cost-free: longer prompts add prefill work and retire elastic expert slots. Precision and original numerical acceptance thresholds are unchanged.
